rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when writing words or a message on an object, including a book.

example.english: I inscribe the blessing on the card.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zoeng1 zuk1 fuk1 se2 hai2 zoeng1 kaa1 dou6

rows.note: Use this when the words are physically cut or engraved into a hard surface.

example.english: I asked the craftsman to inscribe my name on the wooden plaque.
example.traditional: 我叫工匠喺木牌上刻我個名。
example.jyutping: ngo5 giu3 gung1 zoeng6 hai2 muk6 paai4 soeng6 haak1 ngo5 go3 meng2

rows.note: Use this when dedicating a book or other work to a particular person, rather than simply giving it to them.

example.english: I want to inscribe this book as a graduation gift dedicated to my teacher.
example.traditional: 我想將呢本書獻畀老師，作為畢業禮物。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 zoeng1 ni1 bun2 syu1 hin3 bei2 lou5 si1 zok3 wai4 bat1 jip6 lai5 mat6
